terminals.name: provider
terminals.description: Reference ProofMeta Provider Agent on http://127.0.0.1:4100 — serves the signed manifest at /.well-known/proofmeta.json and handles license requests. Run the consumer with PROVIDER_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4100 node examples/consumer/client.mjs, or `npm run e2e` for the full Tier-1 flow (spawns its own provider on 4101).
